components.css: .ds-nav{font-family:var(--font-sans, Geist, Arial, sans-serif);display:flex;gap:27px}.ds-nav a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:32px;color:var(--link);font-size:13px;text-decoration:none;text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-nav a:hover{text-decoration:underline}:is(.ds-link,.ds-nav a,.ds-project a,.ds-contact):focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--link);outline-offset:6px;border-radius:1px;}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-nav{gap:24px}}

components.css: .ds-project{font-family:var(--font-sans, Geist, Arial, sans-serif);padding:25px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);color:var(--ink)}.ds-project h3{margin:0;font-size:17px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:500}.ds-project a{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;min-height:30px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-project svg{width:16px;height:16px;color:var(--muted);transition:transform 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out}.ds-project a:hover span{text-decoration:underline}.ds-project a:hover svg{color:var(--link);transform:translate(2px,-2px)}.ds-description{max-width:64ch;margin:7px 0 0;color:var(--body-ink);font-size:15px;line-height:1.75}.ds-tools{margin:9px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.7}:is(.ds-link,.ds-nav a,.ds-project a,.ds-contact):focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--link);outline-offset:6px;border-radius:1px;}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-project{padding:23px 0}.ds-project h3{font-size:16px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-project svg{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: A personal working paper: warm, untextured paper, readable ink, a serif name and quiet sans-serif supporting text. The layout leaves room for factual descriptions and direct links. Thin rules organize the document without introducing cards or decorative surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Untextured paper and restrained olive links
One readable column with generous margins
Flat sections separated by fine rules

rules.name: The Quiet Ink Rule
rules.body: Keep the palette focused on paper, ink and restrained link emphasis.

dos: Do preserve the paper background and a clear name at the top.
Do use concise, factual descriptions and functioning contact and repository links.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and the skip link.
Do preserve reading order when information sections stack on mobile.
donts: Don't add textured paper, decorative hero artwork, cards or badges to this visual world.
Don't invent skills, repository links or performance claims.
Don't substitute raster artwork for the current text and SVG presentation.
